capture_scope: Actual Chrome approval, RUNNING, COMPLETED, trace, input receipt and reopening captures from a separately authorized one-run batch. Same public upload bytes; invariant earlier candidate/reference illustrations retained. Waiting shortened; not a continuous screencast.

capture_quality.cause: Earlier IAB source screenshots were already blurred before encoding; nominal 1280x720 dimensions did not reveal lost detail.
capture_quality.fix: Replace raw approval/running captures with actual sharp Chrome screenshots. No AI upscaling or invented UI.
capture_quality.metric: Grayscale Laplacian variance on matching source text crop, a relative diagnostic not a perceptual quality guarantee
